note: Baseline — global defaults. MAPE 1.74, very high. Well has multiple phases, frequent shut-ins, erratic 2020+ production.
d_min=0.04 — no change from baseline. Model not reaching terminal decline, so d_min is irrelevant for this well's fit window.
outlier_threshold=0.15 — MAPE improved 1.7418→1.6625. More aggressive outlier removal helps filter erratic 2020+ months. R2 insample dropped (0.67→0.59) but outsample slightly better.
significance_threshold=0.65 — much worse. Fit_months jumped to 170 (vs 119), likely merged phases inappropriately. Filtering too aggressively removed useful phase boundaries.
significance_threshold=0.40 — big improvement! MAPE 1.6625→1.0555. Fit_months=88 (vs 119), better phase isolation focuses on cleaner data. R2 insample improved to 0.70.

significance_threshold=0.30 — another big jump! MAPE 1.0555→0.7843. Fit_months=57, focused on cleanest phase. R2 insample dropped to 0.37 but hindcast improved significantly. significance_threshold now at minimum of search space.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — no change. Optimizer converges to same solution regardless of initial qi guess for this well.
di_initial=0.30 — no change. Optimizer robust to initial decline guess. Need to change data preprocessing or bounds, not initial guesses.
smoothing_window=5 — small improvement, MAPE 0.7843→0.7606. Wider smoothing helps reduce month-to-month noise in this erratic well.
smoothing_window=6 — no improvement, back to 0.7843. Over-smoothing lost a fit month (57 vs 58). Sweet spot is at 5.
peak_merge_distance=5 — no change from v8 (0.7606). Phase merging doesn't affect the already-isolated main phase.
